updates.title: Public events open straight to their form

items.text: ✨ Publicized events (like puzzle hunts) now open straight to their sign-up form when you tap them — no account needed, just your name.
✨ Tick “Publicized event” when you create a form for a club event; sign-ups from people without an account show up in the answers with their name and contact.
✨ Some club events now have a sign-up form — open the event to fill it in and update your answers any time.
✨ Admins can build a form for any club event (“Create a form” when adding or editing an event): add, reorder and edit questions, preview it, and see everyone's answers (with a CSV download).
✨ The main Calendar now has a Clubs button: tap it (then a club) to see that club's events and dated ideas. Tap one to see details and RSVP.
✨ In ⚙️ Settings you can now choose which notifications you get: reminders, announcements, club updates, squad updates and new club events.
✨ Ideas that an admin gives a date now show on the club calendar and the main calendar.
✨ New availability periods can have a fill-in deadline, shown to members; admins get ready-made WhatsApp messages (welcome, new period with deadline) for each person.
✨ New ⚙️ Settings (top-right power button): change your profile picture, last name, username and PIN, see your clubs, and turn notifications on or off.
✨ Admins can see who went to past events and add people who came along.
✨ Club calendar events now show on the main calendar too (name + date) — tap one to log in and RSVP.
✨ When a new availability period opens you'll see a banner on your Clubs page with a button to add yours.
✨ Every availability period is now saved — you can look back at everyone's availability from an older period.
✨ After saving a new period you're asked whether to announce it (banner + push) and can WhatsApp people personally.
✨ New Club calendar: anyone can see event names and dates; log in to see details and RSVP. It's the third button next to Availability and Vote.
✨ People in the club are marked going right away; people from other clubs send a request that an admin accepts.
✨ Admins and club admins can add, edit and remove events and see who's coming (and who's waiting for approval).

✨ All emails (join requests, new events, squad requests, suggestions, new members, backups and the daily digest) now use the 4DASISTAS look — rose header, cream background, brown-outlined cards and pill buttons.
✨ The Accept / Edit / Deny review pages opened from emails got the same look.

✨ Club admins now see the same profile details as the main admin — phone, join date, last sign-in, their sign-up picks (in order) and comments — for people in their clubs and anyone who has asked to join.
✨ Join requests now show who is asking: phone number, their top picks, what they wrote, and whether they'd like to lead.
✨ Club admins can add or remove people from their own clubs (and accept or decline requests), but only the main admin can edit profile details, reset PINs or delete profiles.
✨ After you sign in you'll now see a pop-up like this whenever something new ships — with the update number and what was added or fixed.
✨ Missed one? Open the power button menu (top right) and tap “✨ What's new” any time.
✨ New club: M&M — movies, musicals, museums and other fun exhibitions around the GTA.
✨ The menu tabs (Calendar, Clubs, Squads, Directory) are real links now — right-click one to open it in a new tab.
✨ Fixed: the site could hit a daily Cloudflare limit and go blank. Profiles and availability now run on a faster, limit-free database.
✨ Daily backup email now covers the whole project and arrives once a day.

updates.title: One availability period + new admin page

items.text: ✨ Availability now covers one fixed period (Oct 8–20 for now) — the same days everywhere. Days after it are blocked until the next period opens.
✨ Tap a time in “Everyone's availability” to see who prefers it, who's free, who can't — and who hasn't voted yet.
✨ Submitting your availability now asks “Are you sure?” first: empty times count as free (not preferred), red means you can't.
✨ Club admins: your own login for your clubs — official events, profiles, availability and reminders to your members.
✨ The admin page is organised into three grids (Clubs, Notifications & team, Profiles) with collapsible sections.
✨ Admin: assign squads to any profile, archive past or travelling members, reword the WhatsApp messages, and see “Reminder sent” on reminders.
✨ Admin: pick a club first on the availability calendar, see the best times ranked, and tap a time to see who voted what.
✨ Votes and availability now save on your phone when you're offline and sync automatically when you're back.
✨ Your clubs, Travel, About and Add to Home Screen now float as round bubbles.
✨ Squads: request any squad and get its private invite link once an admin approves you.
✨ Turn on notifications to hear about approvals, reminders and event updates.
